SELECT u.id, u.name, u.age, u.dept_id AS deptId, d.dept_name AS deptName FROM t_user u LEFT JOIN t_dept d ON u.dept_id = d.dept_id
AND u.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
AND u.age = #{age}
ORDER BY u.id DESC
SELECT u.id as userId, u.name as userName, '0123456789' as token FROM t_user u where u.login_id = #{login_id} AND u.login_password = #{login_password} ORDER BY u.id DESC
